# Rose City Plumbing Co.

Rose City Plumbing Co. is a fictional sample plumbing business used to demonstrate a colorful, conversion-focused local service website. It is not a real business. All contact details, service claims, and service-area examples are placeholders.

## Example services shown

- Leak and pipe repair
- Clogged drains
- Water heaters
- Toilets and fixtures
- Remodel rough-ins
- Plumbing checkups

## Demo behavior

- The sample phone number is 503-555-0148 and is not a real service line.
- The contact form is set up for FormSubmit with a clearly marked placeholder recipient (`your-email@example.com`); it will not work until the business replaces this with a real inbox and completes FormSubmit verification.

## Public pages

- Home: https://rosecityplumbing.example/
- Privacy: https://rosecityplumbing.example/privacy-policy.html
- Accessibility: https://rosecityplumbing.example/accessibility-statement.html

The `.example` domain is reserved for documentation and is not a live website.

Before publishing, replace the old sample domain, phone number, and any other demo content with verified details for the real business.
